description: Implement CalculationService with all energy and cost formulas. This service is business logic separated from UI and used by dashboard, analytics, and what-if simulator. Depends on FEAT-001 models.
steps: Implement static methods: kWFromWatts(watts), kWhFromKwAndHours(kw, hours), costFromKwhAndRate(kwh, rate)
Implement calculateMonthlySavings(original EnergyCalculation, proposed EnergyCalculation) - returns map with original, proposed, savings values
Implement getHouseholdDaily(applianceList, rate) - sums all appliance daily consumption
Add input validation: watts > 0, hours >= 0 and <= 24, rate > 0
Write unit tests in test/services/test_calculation_service.dart: test each formula, validate inputs, test household aggregation
acceptance_criteria: All 8 methods implemented with correct formulas: kW=W/1000, kWh=kW*hours, cost=kWh*rate
Input validation rejects invalid values (negative, zero rate, hours > 24)
Flutter analyze shows no errors in service file
verification: Run: flutter test test/services/test_calculation_service.dart — all tests pass, coverage > 80%
Run: flutter analyze lib/services/calculation_service.dart — no errors
